headline: China Q3 GDP expands 4.5% as private investment falls 10.4%
summary: China's gross domestic product grew 4.5% in the third quarter while private sector investment contracted by 10.4%. Chinese equity markets have lost $2.4 trillion in market value since May.
why: China is the world's second-largest economy, playing a central role in global trade, industrial supply chains, and commodities.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Declining private investment points to ongoing domestic headwinds and cautious business sentiment.

why_moved: Contractions in private sector capital deployment confirmed persistent economic cooling in China.
